versions.changelog:
Initial release of ThinkWiki: a skill for local Markdown knowledge base management.

- Enables creation, import, querying, and visualization of a local Markdown wiki.
- Supports file/webpage import, inbox collection, evidence-based Q&A, and generation of HTML artifacts (viewer, graph, governance).
- Handles entity merge review and deterministic entity merges.
- Works with Python 3 on macOS, Linux, and Windows; manages its virtual environment and dependencies.
- Provides unified command entry and explicit intent mapping for common wiki tasks.
- Surfaces workflow and error context clearly for users.
